Join our dedicated Oncology team in a unique and rewarding role supporting older adults with cancer. Working within a specialised multidisciplinary service, you will partner with an Oncologist and Geriatrician to deliver comprehensive, patient-centred care for older cancer patients. Through the use of Practical Geriatric Assessment (PGA), the service identifies frailty and other geriatric syndromes to optimise treatment outcomes, enhance quality of life and support holistic care planning.

As the Geriatric Oncology CNC, you will provide expert clinical assessment, care coordination and leadership for older oncology patients with complex needs. You will work closely with patients, families and multidisciplinary teams to identify vulnerabilities, coordinate supportive care interventions and contribute to improved patient outcomes.


Key responsibilities include:



Conducting advanced clinical assessments and coordinating care for older oncology patients.


Participating in the weekly Geriatric Oncology Clinic.


Supporting multidisciplinary care planning and decision-making.


Facilitating referrals and access to supportive care services.


Monitoring, collecting and interpreting clinical data and project outcomes.


Contributing to service development, quality improvement and patient-centred care initiatives.



This is a fixed-term opportunity at .3EFT (24 hours per fortnight) until February 2028.

You are an experienced oncology nurse with advanced clinical knowledge and a passion for improving outcomes for older adults. You thrive in collaborative multidisciplinary environments and are committed to delivering high-quality, evidence-based care.


To be successful in this role, you will have:



Current AHPRA registration as a Registered Nurse, essential

Excellent communication, organisation and care coordination skills.


Demonstrated ability to work autonomously and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.


Strong clinical judgement, including knowing when to act and when to escalate.


Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications and electronic health systems.



Experience in quality improvement, research activities, anti-cancer drug administration and electronic medical records will be highly regarded.


Join us and play a key role in enhancing the care and outcomes of older people living with cancer.
